A '''heavy battle droid model''' was a model of combat [[Droid/Legends|droid]] used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. Several of these droids were stationed on the streets of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] as escorts of a Trade Federation [[Giant armadillo|aerial tank droid]].<ref name="GBA" />
